data.title: 提丰 · 书店里选下次一起去的地方
data.description: 周末书店的旅行书架前，提丰穿灰呢短外套与莓紫长裙，抱着一本打开的图册。她用指尖点着湖边木屋的照片，把书页朝你倾斜，眼神询问你愿不愿意一起去。
data.action: 抱着打开的图册，指向湖边木屋照片并向你展示
data.mood: 认真规划共同出游的期待
data.promptProse: Typhon holds an open travel book before the bookstore's travel shelves, pointing to a lakeside cabin photograph and tilting the spread toward her companion. Her charcoal wool jacket, ivory blouse and berry-purple midi skirt remain in the eye-level cowboy view. Book spines form rows behind her. Diffuse window light brightens the photograph and silver jacket toggles, shading the paper where her fingertip rests.
